hints: Each figure has one black dot (●) in a row of four dots. Watch where it is.
The black dot is in the 1st spot, then the 2nd, then the 3rd.

solution.methodName: Check one change at a time

steps.action: Check what stays the same: each figure is a row of 4 dots with exactly one black dot (●).
Track the black dot: it is in spot 1, then spot 2, then spot 3.
steps.why: Counting the spots from the left turns the picture into a number series: 1, 2, 3.

steps.action: The black dot moves one spot to the right each time, so next it is in spot 4.
The next figure has the black dot in the last spot. The answer is ○○○●.

trapNotes.○○●○: This repeats the last figure, so the dot did not move. The dot moves one spot every step.
trapNotes.○●○○: This moves the dot back to the left. The dot has been moving right: spot 1, 2, 3.
